items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: He used to play a lot with Chris Kelly and them different bands.

ctx.x: What kind of stuff did he play?
He was a pretty fair drummer. He used to play a lot with Chris Kelly and them different bands. Then we had another one with my favorite in them days was Faso.

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: you had, these three bands was really popular in them days. At that place was Kid Rene, Sam Morgan, and Chris Kelly... And the best group for me could play that number was Chris Kelly.

ctx.x: Two yards, you see, facing, as we come in on that street, hominist street, facing the club. Well, to your right of the building, I see the other day when we was up there, they had some houses given to them. Well, they had a yard on that side. And then, you know, to the left of the building, like this would be the front of the building, like this, this would be the right, like I'm facing you, and this would be the left.
